name: @mentu/monitor-protocol
description: An epistemic layer over pub/sub: monitors as enduring daemons that emit evidence with provenance, keep a computed state, and are subscribed to with a durable cursor. CloudEvents envelope, MCP extension door, Nostr-shaped filters, Kafka-shaped delivery.

scripts.build: node --eval "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && node --eval "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/index.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);fs.chmodSync(f,0o755)"
scripts.verify:release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run conform && npm run check:release

author: Mentu AI (https://github.com/mentu-ai)
